summary: Build a transparent evidence map and synthesis from traceable research sources.
intents: do a literature review on sleep and memory
summarize recent papers on retrieval-augmented generation
map the evidence for this treatment
find gaps in the research on remote work productivity
build a table of studies with methods and findings
prerequisites: access to bibliographic records and full text where available
verify: Search strategy, databases and inclusion criteria are recorded
Every study in the synthesis has a full citation
Conflicting findings and study quality are discussed
